info.description:
Provides functionality for managing freight requests for quotation, including the created freight quotations, as part of the freight tendering process when integrating SAP Business Network for Logistics with other systems.
This specification describes the API from the perspective of SAP Business Network for Logistics as the provider of the API.
Other systems call the defined endpoints within SAP Business Network for Logistics.
info.title: Provider API for Freight Tendering

externalDocs.description: Click here to access detailed implementation documentation.

post.summary: Creates a freight quotation for a freight request for quotation
post.description:
Creates a freight quotation for a freight request for quotation in SAP Business Network for Logistics.
With this functionality, a carrier can accept or reject a freight request for quotation.
When accepting, an alternative price can be proposed if permitted by the ordering party.
The alternative price is the amount for which the carrier agrees to execute the transportation.
When accepting, alternative loading and unloading times for transportation stages can be proposed, if permitted by the ordering party.
The alternative times are the points in time for which the carrier agrees to accept the freight request for quotation.
When rejecting, a reason code can be provided.

eu10.description:
To use the EU10 data center API, you must obtain the OAuth client credentials (client ID and secret). 
To get the OAuth client credentials, create a customer incident on SAP support portal with the component as SBN-LBN-INT. 
Provide the SAP Business Network for Logistics ID created for your account and the email address to receive your client credentials. 
Specify the target integration platform as ‘Multi-Cloud (new)’ and the title as ‘SAP BN4L Integration Platform Migration: Request for new OAuth 2.0 credential’. 
Once you receive the credentials, pass the details to SAP HANA Cloud Platform token endpoint to obtain an access token.

responseCode.description:
The response to the freight request for quotation.
The freight request for quotation can be accepted or rejected.
* AP - Accept the freight request for quotation
* RE - Reject the freight request for quotation

rejectionReasonCode.description:
The reason (code) selected by the carrier to explain why they rejected the freight request for quotation.
Should be used together with `responseCode` when response code `RE` is provided.
* LBN_CAPA - No capacity
* LBN_OTHERS - Other
* LBN_PRICE - Price
* LBN_TIME - No time

transportationStages.description:
Information about a section of the transportation chain represented by a freight request for quotation.
Transportation stages can be used to propose different loading and unloading times if the property `datesAreNegotiable` for the referenced freight request for quotation is `true`.
The alternative times are the times for which the carrier agrees to execute a freight request for quotation.
Transportation stages are considered only if the freight request for quotation is accepted (`responseCode` = `AP`).
In other cases, it is ignored.

proposedLoadingStartDateTime.description:
Time when loading starts, as proposed by the carrier.
Format must be compliant with RFC 3339 Internet date/time format.
proposedLoadingStartDateTime.default: Timestamp as provided during creation of the freight request for quotation.

proposedLoadingEndDateTime.description:
Time when loading ends, as proposed by the carrier.
Format must be compliant with RFC 3339 Internet date/time format.
proposedLoadingEndDateTime.default: Time as provided during creation of the freight request for quotation.

proposedUnloadingStartDateTime.description:
Time when unloading starts, as proposed by the carrier.
Format must be compliant with RFC 3339 Internet date/time format.
proposedUnloadingStartDateTime.default: Time as provided during creation of the freight request for quotation.

proposedUnloadingEndDateTime.description:
Time when unloading ends, as proposed by the carrier.
Format must be compliant to RFC 3339 Internet date/time format.
proposedUnloadingEndDateTime.default: Times as provided during creation of the freight request for quotation.

value.description: Amount that the carrier proposes as the charge for executing the freight request for quotation.

currency.description: Format must be compliant with SAP Global Data Type `CurrencyCode` (`listID` = `4217`, `listAgencyID` = `5`). [Codelist](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_LBN_FC_OPTION/40f43410e8a64dc98792a5e610e81017/c5ff86c3b2c744b4aab2ade9d9b1f05e.html)

PostFreightQuotation_proposalPrice.description:
Amount that the carrier proposes as the charge for executing the freight request for quotation.
Price proposal can be used to propose an alternative price in case property `priceIsNegotiable` of the referenced freight request for quotation is `true`.
Price proposal is considered only in the case of accept (`responseCode` = `AP`).
In other cases it is ignored.

text.description:
Natural-language text with additional information about the freight request for quotation.
The note is language-independent.
